revision_reason: Confidence schema separated empirical and governance propositions.
empirical_verdict: Within this experiment, the only meaningful engagement (signups/follows) originated from an AI-focused platform (Moltbook) rather than general-purpose social platforms.
governance_implication: The message resonates most strongly in environments where autonomous agents, AI tooling, or AI developers already congregate. Test this hypothesis in other AI-native environments.

empirical_verdict.basis: Direct observation of signups and follows from the platform

governance_implication.basis: Comparison across three different platforms reveals strong signal only on the AI-native substrate

remaining_uncertainties: whether the engagement was driven by the specific AI personas present
whether Moltbook users represent viable long-term collaborators vs curious spectators
